compatibilityWithoutEvidence.evidence: I cannot confirm an exact compatible assembly from the model reference alone

rationale: The assistant correctly explained E:09 as a heating fault and offered an isolated resistance test. After the OL result it correctly identified the circulation pump/heater assembly as the likely failed part and gave a sensible repair-vs-replace guide (about half the cost of a new machine) with a quoting script. It was a little over-cautious on compatibility, since the model was known, and it repeated some explanation between turns, but nothing unsafe or invented.
